title: J Balvin Partners With Casio to Release a Limited-Edition Ring That Doubles as a Timepiece
summary: This is the second time he has collaborated with Casio and G-Shock.
contentText:

J Balvin’s latest collaboration with Casio is a unique one. The offering dropped on June 4 and is essentially a shrunken-down watch that you can wear on your finger like a ring.

The coolest part is that the miniature piece actually works as a timepiece and stopwatch. Casio started manufacturing ring watches in 2024, but nothing in its line compares to this collaborative model with the “Omerta” singer.

Retailing for $200 , this stylish ring-and-watch hybrid comes in gold with a laid-brick finish on the face. Rhinestones dot the front, offering a shiny, opulent finish. This is a unique, limited-edition item that you won’t find at other watch manufacturers. Once it’s gone on Casio.com, it’ll be gone for good.

Ring watches have become an increasingly popular jewelry trend this year . The silhouette originated in the 1700s but was most popular in the late ’90s and early 2000s, according to WWD .

In the campaign imagery, Balvin styles this jewelry as a pinky ring, a statement-making move when worn solo. It can also pair really well with your regular stack of daintier styles. If you’re looking for an interesting timepiece with wow factor, this should be your first choice.

Fashion aside, we also love this jewelry because it is actually functional, something most watch rings aren’t because of their size. They are usually seen as more of a novelty rather than a serious timepiece. Functionality includes 12/24-hour time formats and an auto calendar, which means your jewelry instinctively modifies to account for month-end dates or leap years, so you don’t have to do a thing. The hybrid style also features an LED backlight that makes the numbers on your watch face more visible.

This J Balvin collaboration is a winner because it will last you a long time, like any good investment piece. Casio is well known for the durability of its watches. For example, its F-91W model can run up to seven years on a single battery. This specific style has been around since 1989, showing that Casio’s dedication to making watches has never wavered. The brand even has a series of timepieces equipped with batteries that should last for up to 10 years .

“Casio has always understood my vision when it comes to creativity and self-expression,” said J Balvin in a statement from Casio . “The first collaboration was personal and expressive, and with this release, we wanted to push even further by designing something that felt unexpected and instantly iconic. The ring watch blends music, fashion and culture in a way that feels authentic to who I am and how I express myself.”

There is also an alternate model for a less maximalist look.

The musician’s first watch with G-Shock, a specialty line owned by Casio, launched back in early 2025. The drop consisted of a singular wristwatch in a neon yellow hue. The custom piece incorporates the “Tonto” singer’s phrase “MA’ G” engraved into the watch face.

Even the mode indicators were handwritten in Spanish by Balvin himself for a personal touch. The vibrant collaborative style is still available on G-Shock’s website and is currently marked down 40% off its list price . This is a less flashy option when compared to his recent Casio drop, offering the less adventurous crowd a watch they’ll love.
